directionSent: deep, resonant, booming, noble and ancient
heardByWhisper: You hear a roar, then a great flapping sound.  A strong rush of air batters the party as a large silver dragon lands before the adventurers.  In a booming voice it says,  You fools! I am a good silver dragon, not the evil leader of Flan.  Don't you know that we metallic dragons are good creatures?  What will you do?
